generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: clean transparent-background flat logo asset for a website; do not render a poster or mockup.
Primary request: a precise original logo for the text "Tao Cars". Exact spelling, only these two words.
Logo: a single simple custom angular T glyph made of solid deep graphite with a small terracotta cutout, paired with clean large solid-ink sans-serif type "Tao Cars". Similar precision to a well-executed Swiss typographic identity.
Composition: ONE professional compact horizontal wordmark with emblem; floating on REAL ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. Background must be fully transparent outside the exact colored logo shape, including in all corners; no black, gray, colored, blurred, gradient, or textured pixels outside the logo shapes.
Palette: exactly solid graphite #17191C and terracotta #BD6037. Absolutely NO gradients, light sources, shading, vignettes, glows, blur, shadows, bevel, soft edges, smoke or atmospheric effects.
Constraints: text exactly "Tao Cars", simple flat vector-like surfaces, decisive hard edges, clean proportions, ample transparent padding, no extra text, no car icon, no yin-yang, no 3D. Must be a transparent PNG logo, not a design presentation. Independent proposal not the dealer's official mark.

rejectedPredecessor.reason: First attempt had opaque dark poster background and glow despite transparent request; discarded; second clean transparent logo generated.

holdReasons: Genuine source branding not visually compared against concept
